method: Static source review + live endpoint probing (ports 3001/3002), SQLite inspection (WAL tables/indexes/row counts via ./voxaria.db, ./database/auth.db), PM2 process/state inspection, Python/Redis toolchain checks, and a direct BullMQ queue.add probe.

critical_issues.issue: Redis 3.0.504 too old for BullMQ v5; karaoke queue cannot accept jobs and worker spin-loops writing a 7.5GB error log (disk-fill risk).
critical_issues.fix: Upgrade Redis to >= 5.0 (Memurai 5.x/7.x or WSL Redis), truncate/rotate logs, enable pm2-logrotate.

critical_issues.issue: tRPC contracts router is 100% stubbed (all 50 procedures throw 'Backend implementation required'); any tRPC-based web client is dead on arrival.
critical_issues.fix: Implement procedures against existing REST services or remove tRPC surface.

critical_issues.issue: Orchestrator shared-secret auth cannot work end-to-end: no .env on orchestrator (ephemeral key), no key sent by MusicBot client, /ai command therefore always fails.
critical_issues.fix: Create voxaria-orchestrator/.env with ORCHESTRATOR_API_KEY; add Authorization header to OrchestratorClient; keep key in MusicBot/.env.

critical_issues.issue: State persistence is a silent no-op (StatePersistence constructed without dependencies) and event store only initializes on restore path; restarts lose queue/playback state.
critical_issues.fix: Construct StatePersistence with {stateManager, languageManager, embedManager}; initializeEventStore on player creation; null-guard eventStore in cleanup(); fix downloadFile getter.

critical_issues.issue: Role system has no source of truth: roles.json missing -> every web user is guest(0), owner is 3; staff/user/vip tiers unreachable; casbin collapsed.
critical_issues.fix: Create roles.json (or migrate users table) and wire getUserRole + permission-service to it.

critical_issues.issue: Production deployment artifacts not current: .env.production placeholders, NODE_ENV=development in docker-compose, no migrations, orchestrator not in ecosystem.config.js, health.js dead code, helmet hoisted to repo root.
critical_issues.fix: Fill prod env, add drizzle migrations, add orchestrator PM2 app, mount or delete health.js, vendor helmet into MusicBot deps.
